svg.title: Judging success: one task meets the bar, one does not
svg.desc: Dot plots on blind 60-episode test sets with the scale-up quality bar drawn in. Plates: release-anchored review reaches balanced accuracy 0.936 (LEVI from segments 0.808, a direct call 0.782) and judges 12.8% of failures as successes (38.5%, 43.6%); both meet the bar of 0.90 and 15%. Screws: 0.756 and 48.7%, both miss it. Time-segment labelling is at parity with a direct call; whether curated data improves a policy is not established.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
